description: Get view statistics for a share: total view count, unique viewers, where the traffic came from, last viewed time, created time, and whether the share is deleted. Use when the user asks 'did anyone see my share', 'how many views', 'check who looked at it', 'where did the traffic come from', 'is the demo getting traffic'.  No edit token required — anyone with the slug can read stats (matches the product’s "link is the secret" model).
name: qhs_stats
